description_full: Greenfire Resources Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, and operation of oil and gas properties in the Athabasca oil sands region of Alberta, Canada. The company's principal asset includes the Hangingstone Facilities which consist of the Expansion Asset and the Demo Asset located in south of Fort McMurray, Alberta. Greenfire Resources Ltd. is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

financial_summary: Greenfire Resources Ltd. is a small-cap energy business with a $1.9B market cap on $410M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at -7% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome. Operating margins are expanding by +17.0pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 103% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $17M in free cash flow — roughly 4 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.87× so those profits are backed by real cash.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 2.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Net dilution runs at 11.2% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.

Geopolitical supply shocks — wars, sanctions, and OPEC decisions create volatility that no hedging programme can fully neutralise.
